paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between prompt length and accuracy, comparing two datasets labeled as "mmsd" and "mmsd2". The x-axis, labeled "Prompt Length," uses a linear scale ranging from 2 to 16, with tick marks at intervals of 2 units. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and also uses a linear scale, with values ranging from 77 to 81, and tick marks at intervals of 1 unit. The line representing "mmsd" is red with circular markers and a solid style. It starts at a y-value of 81 at x=2, dips to approximately 80.5 at x=4, and slightly increases to end at 80.6 at x=16. The "mmsd2" line is yellow with circular markers and a solid style. It begins at a y-value of 77.5 at x=2, drops to 76.5 at x=4, rises again to about 77.3 at x=8, and then declines steadily to reach 76.2 at x=16. A legend is there at the top right of the line plot to match different lines to their labels.
